quarterly_data.signal: Zhen Ding MOPS filing: the board of subsidiary Leading Interconnect Semiconductor Technology (Shenzhen) approved on 09-03-2026 an investment to build an advanced packaging substrate base project in Bao'an District, Shenzhen, as land for production and operations, to meet the subsidiary's business-development needs. Total project investment is expected to be not less than RMB 120 hundred million (final total subject to actual investment), of which the land-transfer fee for the plot to be acquired is expected not to exceed RMB 2 hundred million. Investment is expected to be made in phases with project progress from the second half of 2026; stated purpose: to meet operating needs and expand the advanced packaging substrate business. Parts of the project still require approval or filing with the relevant government authorities and the state-owned construction land-use-right transfer procedures.
quarterly_data.figure: total investment not less than RMB 120 hundred million; land-transfer fee not more than RMB 2 hundred million; phased from H2 2026
